'''2015 European Championship Day 2 Eric Spijksma LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Eric Spijksma]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Eric Spijksma]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Username:''' Ericobasso
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
